chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“And whoever turns away from My remembrance, then indeed for him is a straitened life.”
He said: “It means thereby the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.”
I said: “And We shall raise him on the Day of Resurrection blind?”

He said: “It means blind in sight in the Hereafter, and blind in heart in this world from the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.” He said: “And he will be bewildered on the Day of Resurrection, saying:”
“Why have You raised me blind while I had been seeing?”
“Thus did Our signs come to you, but you forgot them.”

He said: “The signs are the Imams عليهم السلام, so you forgot them. And ‘thus today you are forgotten’ means: you abandoned them, and likewise today you will be abandoned in the Fire just as you abandoned the Imams عليهم السلام; so you did not obey their command and did not listen to their word.”
I said: “And thus do We recompense one who is excessive and does not believe in the signs of his Lord, and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting?”

He said: “It means one who associates someone else with the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and does not believe in the signs of his Lord, and abandons the Imams out of obstinacy; thus he does not follow their traces and does not hold to their wilayah.”
I said: “Allah is Gentle to His servants; He provides for whomsoever He wills.”
He said: “The wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.”
I said: “Whoever desires the tillage of the Hereafter.”

He said: “It is recognition of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام and the Imams; ‘We increase for him in his tillage.’” He said: “We increase him from it.” He said: “He will receive his full share from their government.”
“And whoever desires the tillage of this world, We give him from it, and he has no share in the Hereafter.”
He said: “He has no share in the government of truth along with al-Qāʾim.”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْآيَاتُ: the signs, interpreted here as the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams عليهم السلام as divinely designated guides
key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection when people are raised and judged
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْحَقِّ: the government or dominion of truth, here associated with al-Qāʾim
key_terms.مُتَحَيِّرٌ: bewildered or confounded on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.وَلَايَةَ: divinely appointed authority and allegiance, here referring to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How do Shia hadith interpret Quranic verses about turning away from Allah’s remembrance in relation to the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents a tafsir in which the Quranic verses are explained in relation to the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام and the Imams عليهم السلام. Turning away from divine remembrance is interpreted as turning away from their authority, which results in blindness, loss in the Hereafter, and exclusion from the rule of truth with al-Qāʾim.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Al Husayn Bin Abdul Rahman, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[20:124] And whoever ignores My Guidance will live a woeful life.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means ignoring the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’.
I said, ‘and We will Resurrect him on the Day of Judgement, blind?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means blind of vision in the Hereafter, and blind of the heart in the world from the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>. And he would be confused on the Day of Judgment
[20:125] He shall say: Lord! Why have You Resurrected me blind and I was a seeing one beforehand? [20:126] He will say: Even so, Our Signs came to you.
but you forgot them; even thus shall you be Forsaken this Day.

You forgot, meaning neglected them<sup>asws</sup>, and similarly you will be neglected in the Fire just as you neglected the Imams<sup>asws</sup>. So you did not obey their<sup>asws</sup> orders and did not listen to their<sup>asws</sup> speech’.
I said, ‘[20:127] And thus do We Recompense him who is extravagant and does not believe in the Signs of his Lord, and the Punishment of the Hereafter is severer and more lasting’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It Means the one who associates with the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> someone else, and does not believe in the Signs of his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and deliberately neglects the Imams<sup>asws</sup>. So he neither follows their<sup>asws</sup> Ahadeeth, nor acknowledges their<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah’.
I said, ‘[42:19] Allah is Gentle to His servants; He Gives sustenance to whom He Desires to’.
I said, ‘[42:20] Whoever desires the gain of the Hereafter’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Recognition of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup>,

We will give him more of that gain. Heasws said: ‘Weazwj shall Increase him from it’. Heasws said: ‘He would be fulfilled his share from theirasws government. and whoever desires the gain of this world, We give him of it, and in the Hereafter he has no portion.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There wouldn’t be a share for him, in the government of the truth along with Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>’.
